title: galium × ochroleucum var. guillemotii
intro: Galium × ochroleucum var. guillemotii, commonly known as a hybrid species of bedstraw, is a plant belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and alleviate digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Galium × ochroleucum var. guillemotii include analgesic, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as pain, muscle spasms, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
